title: PNP: Anti-drug ops continue despite massive Asean security deployment

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) continues its anti-drug operations despite the massive deployment of personnel for the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits, seizing around P20.4 million worth of suspected shabu in Taguig City. “We cannot allow our heightened security responsibilities for the Asean Summit to create opportunities for criminal groups,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said on Tuesday. Nearly 20,000 police personnel have been deployed alongside other government agencies to secure summit venues, hotels, billeting areas and motorcade routes.
